headline: Moss, USC Ground Game Close Out Colorado in Fourth Quarter
dek: USC opens at 1-0 atop the Western Pacific while Colorado drops to 0-1 and faces Georgia next.
body: USC faced third-and-2 at the Colorado 20 with 45 seconds left and a 27-21 lead when Miller Moss handed to Woody Marks, who surged four yards for the first down that let the Trojans kneel out the clock and seal the win.

Colorado struck first on a 15-yard strike from Roger Anderson to Sam Hart at 12:53 of the first quarter, but USC answered with a 13-play, 80-yard drive capped by Moss finding Milo Beard for a one-yard score at 1:32. A Denis Lynch field goal made it 10-7 at the half. Moss hit Beard again from three yards at 6:16 of the third to push the lead to 17-7, then Anderson found Matthew Golden from three yards at 0:51 to pull Colorado within three. Moss connected with Kyle Ford for a four-yard touchdown at 11:06 of the fourth, Lynch added a 49-yard field goal at 6:05 for a 27-14 cushion, and Anderson hit Golden again from eight yards at 3:20 to set the final margin.

USC controlled the line of scrimmage with 161 rushing yards to Colorado's 56 and converted 11 of 17 third downs compared to 6 of 12 for the Buffaloes, a disparity that fueled a 35:18 to 24:42 time-of-possession edge. Moss threw for 276 yards and three touchdowns without an interception, posting a 110.8 rating that ranks sixth in the PCFL, while Carter Myers added 86 yards on 12 carries to sit third in the league in rushing. Anderson threw for 312 yards and three scores but lost a fumble and threw an interception, and Colorado's lone explosive play after halftime was a 41-yard catch by Hart that came too late to change the outcome.

The victory lifts USC to 1-0, keeps them atop the power poll at No. 1 and extends their division lead in the Western Pacific, while Colorado falls to 0-1, sits third in the Western Central behind Notre Dame, and drops to No. 10 in the poll. The Buffaloes host Georgia next week, and the Trojans welcome Michigan State, both opponents also 0-1 after the opening weekend.
turningPoint: USC converted third-and-2 at the Colorado 20 with 45 seconds remaining when Woody Marks gained four yards, allowing the Trojans to run out the clock.
byTheNumbers: USC rushed for 161 yards to Colorado's 56, dominating possession with a 35:18 to 24:42 advantage.
The Trojans converted 65 percent of third downs (11 of 17) while the Buffaloes managed 50 percent (6 of 12).
Miller Moss threw three touchdowns with zero interceptions for a 110.8 passer rating, sixth in the PCFL.
Colorado committed two turnovers (one fumble lost, one interception) to USC's zero.

unsungHero.name: Carter Myers
unsungHero.why: Rushed for 86 yards on 12 carries (7.2 per attempt), including a 36-yard burst, ranking third in the league in rushing yards and sustaining the drives that wore down Colorado's defense.
